integrity: The analytic proof establishes the claim; symbolic and numerical arithmetic checks are reproducibility aids, not an exhaustive search or independent validation. Exact uniqueness follows from compactness and the implicit function theorem.
limitations: Local real two-dimensional result near p=2 at skew parameter one only; no explicit neighborhood radius, general-dimensional classification or all-exponent formula; older unindexed equivalent formulations remain possible.
title: Second-order Hilbert departure of the Birkhoff skew-isosceles constant on real \(\ell_p^2\)
